items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: And Dick Sherman wasn’t with us on that but Phil was and he

ctx.x: You did three clubs in a row?

Yeah, they were all in the same building. So we played there. One was called the Flying Dutchman, another was called Scheherazade, and the other one was called The Galleries. The Galleries was a great big club with posh curtains and stuff. And we were a show band. And so that was that. And Dick Sherman wasn’t with us on that but Phil was and he

remembers those things, but they know very little about the work-up to it. I said, “Wow, we’re going to Europe and this is when we leave” and all of that, but they had no idea about the contracts and the stuff like that. So that’s an aspect that, as I said, it was like going to business school.
